tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. White, decided by Nimish on 9 Nov 2026 (docs/decisions/2026-11-09-white-ground-for-the-site.md); it replaces the lime wash and paper-warm for the site only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: A rail, a sunken strip, the head of a table, the trail. One step off the ground, never a card with a shadow.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: A bordered block on the ground (a card, a details block). Same as the ground in light; the border does the work.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and icons. Never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Purpose lines, captions, column heads, the second line of a row. 6.6:1 on ground in light.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around blocks. Decoration only: never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: The edge of an input, a button, a search field. 3:1 or better on ground.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and the one main action. Clay 700 in light (6:1); never on a child.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3 px focus ring on anything a keyboard reaches.

tokens.name: brand-clay
tokens.usage: The school's terracotta: the mark, the active group's underline, the accent of the trail. Rationed; never a child's colour.

tokens.name: brand-basalt
tokens.usage: The rock the school stands on. The wordmark, the one dark button.

tokens.name: brand-olive
tokens.usage: The courtyard tree. Green for done, secure, right.

tokens.name: brand-bamboo
tokens.usage: The pavilion. Amber for waiting, to confirm, this week.

tokens.name: brand-haldi
tokens.usage: Turmeric. A part of a page that needs a person (an outline, never a fill behind text).

tokens.name: brand-monsoon
tokens.usage: The pond. Quiet blue-grey for charts and for Numeracy.

tokens.name: brand-bark
tokens.usage: Tree bark. The brown of Language.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Sand. The fixed parts of a day (settling, fruit, lunch).

tokens.name: state-ok
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a green state: done, secure, right, results in. Always with its word.

tokens.name: state-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a green chip or cell.

tokens.name: state-wait
tokens.usage: Text and icon of an amber state: waiting, to confirm, this week, practising, wrong.

tokens.name: state-wait-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind an amber chip or cell.

tokens.name: state-late
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a red state: do now, late, a clash, for you to judge. Work only; a child is never red.

tokens.name: state-late-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a red chip. Rare on any screen.

tokens.name: state-quiet
tokens.usage: Text and icon of a grey state: to do, not seen, blank, emerging, absent. Nothing to do yet.

tokens.name: state-quiet-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a grey chip or cell.

tokens.name: subject-numeracy
tokens.usage: The left edge and tag of a Numeracy period or timetable cell.

tokens.name: subject-numeracy-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a Numeracy timetable cell.

tokens.name: subject-language
tokens.usage: The left edge and tag of a Language period.

tokens.name: subject-language-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a Language timetable cell.

tokens.name: subject-arts
tokens.usage: The left edge and tag of an Arts or Music period (haldi, darkened for text).

tokens.name: subject-arts-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an Arts or Music timetable cell.

tokens.name: subject-fixed
tokens.usage: The fixed parts of the day: settling, fruit, lunch, dispersal.

tokens.name: subject-fixed-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a fixed timetable cell.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: The one h1 of a page.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: A section or card title that names a thing.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Your periods in order. Tap one for what to teach.
styles.usage: The purpose line under a title; at most 140 characters.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Counts 20 and says how many without recounting.
styles.usage: Everything a person reads. Never smaller for a status, a label or an action.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, buttons, tabs, column heads, the rail.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The one line above a title that says what kind of thing this is. Uppercase, letter-spaced.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and sources only. Never a status or an action.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its word, inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a card; the side gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks of a page; the main column's padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Above a new section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the title block and the first block of work.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page bottom.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: The least height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, buttons, cells. The brand's square corner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: A chip for a state of work (do now, this week, done) and the round badge of a count.
